question: What happens if you fall into the Mariana Trench?
title: What Happens If You Fall Into the Mariana Trench?
answer: You drown within minutes near the surface, while the crushing pressure flattens your lungs as you sink into freezing darkness. It takes hours for your body to reach the seafloor nearly 11,000 metres down.
steps: You slip into the open ocean and start sinking into the water without any breathing gear.
Within 200 metres, sunlight begins to fade away and your lungs run out of oxygen completely.
Past 1,000 metres, complete darkness surrounds you and the growing water pressure crushes your air spaces flat.
Your body continues to sink for several hours through water that is close to freezing.
At nearly 11,000 metres down, you reach the seafloor under more than 1,000 times normal surface pressure.
